name: app-fitness-performance-phones-purple-accent
title: Fitness performance screens with black pills and violet gradient
whatItIs: A case-study board with a big light headline 'Dynamic Workout Guidance' and three phones: a performance chart with a red highlighted column, a violet gradient home with a body silhouette, and a big daily score in black chips and violet tiles.
whatItMeans: Precise and motivating, with a premium athletic tone from the black and white base and single violet accent.
techniques: Use one saturated gradient screen among white screens as a hero moment.
Set the primary figure (points) in huge light type.
Highlight a period in a chart with a coloured vertical band.
Use black rounded chips for secondary stats.
bestFor: Case study layouts with editorial whitespace

vocabulary.definition: The one screen given the strongest colour.
A vertical tinted area marking a selected range on a chart.
A small rounded box with a label and value.
A minimal figure used as a data anchor.
